description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the GeoZone model in the OpenCart platform, providing methods to retrieve Geo Zone data from the database.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: A model class for handling geographical zone data in the OpenCart localisation module.

methods.name: getGeoZone
methods.description: Retrieves a specific geo zone from the database based on the provided geo zone ID, country ID, and zone ID.

methods.name: getGeoZones
methods.description: Retrieves all geo zones from the database.
